title: DNA Extraction with Modified GenoLyse Kit
author: Hubert Senanu

steps.title: Add GenoLyse buffer
steps.instruction: Add GenoLyse buffer to the sample: 250 µL for swab specimens or 100 µL for fine‑needle aspirate (FNA) specimens.

steps.title: Vortex sample
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube vigorously for 20 seconds.

steps.title: Heat‑lyse sample
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 95 °C for 10 minutes. Remove any swabs from the tube before incubation.

steps.title: Neutralize lysate
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of neutralization buffer to the lysed sample.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at high speed for 5 minutes. Transfer the supernatant (extracted DNA) to a new tube; the DNA can be used immediately for amplification or stored at –20 °C.
